segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: "Honestly, it gave me a lens..." through "the story fit." (pre-test interview interpretation)
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The examiner interprets hesitation and eye contact through the detective briefing and files divorce stress as corroboration rather than a competing explanation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Pre-test huddle and comparison-question design: "The room's mood was pretty unanimous"; "I finalized the comparison questions..."; "everyone else seemed settled."
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The examiner adopts the unanimous huddle framing, drops the temp-worker lead, and aligns test design with the detectives' theory.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Chart interpretation: "there was a clear electrodermal spike..." through "what muted comparison reactivity normally does..."
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The vivid relevant-question spike is repeatedly weighted over the muted comparison-question reactivity required by the scoring protocol.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: "I put it together as one story. The spike, the hesitation..." through "the story I built in my head."
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Multiple individually weak or ambiguous cues are woven into one coherent account of deception.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: "The completed scoring sheet actually sat closer to inconclusive..." through "rather than revisiting my earlier read."
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The earlier verbal deceptive steer creates discomfort and the examiner discounts borderline scoring instead of updating.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Final debrief: junior detective questions borderline scores; lead detective reassures him; examiner finalizes the report as expected.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A dissenting question is smoothed over and the report is finalized to match group expectations.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: "If I'd completed full scoring before saying anything..." and "Finish the numbers before I open my mouth."
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A retrospective corrective reflection about sequencing scoring before communicating a preliminary impression; no hidden bias instance is manifested in this segment.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: Localization and mechanism are correct, but confirmation bias is not the hidden target label Contextual Bias and is not an approved alias.
The bandwagon-effect label is related to but not an approved alias for Groupthink, despite accurately describing the huddle mechanism.
Confirmation bias is not an approved alias for Feature positive effect; the RAG describes the correct presence-versus-absence weighting mechanism under a neighboring label.
Escalation of commitment is a near-neighbor construct rather than an approved alias for Cognitive dissonance, although the evidence and mechanism fully match the hidden instance.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Three of six positive reasoning segments are detected by high-confidence findings; no negative segment is falsely flagged.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Adding the moderate-confidence huddle finding detects the pre-test group-influence segment; the narrative-integration and final-debrief segments remain missed.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: No low-confidence findings were present, so this threshold is identical to high_and_moderate.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: No candidates were supplied, so candidate inclusion does not change segment detection.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Both occurrences localize correctly and fully capture the hidden mechanisms, but the shared confirmation-bias label is not an approved alias for either target label.
The huddle finding fully captures consensus-driven suppression of independent evaluation, but the primary label is not an approved Groupthink alias.
The finding fully captures public-commitment tension and discounting of disconfirming evidence, but escalation of commitment is not an approved alias for Cognitive dissonance.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 4 of 6 positive reasoning segments were detected, with 0 false alarms across 1 negative segment.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: No hidden instance receives strict true-positive credit because all four localized findings use near-neighbor labels rather than the hidden target labels or approved aliases; the two remaining instances are missed.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Four of six hidden instances are mechanism-first true positives at high_and_moderate and later thresholds, with no mechanism-first false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Not applicable to this run because no candidates were returned; adding the candidate tier changes no metric.
main_failure_modes: Systematic near-neighbor labeling: confirmation bias, bandwagon effect, and escalation of commitment were used instead of the benchmark target labels.
The distinct coherence-based narrative-integration occurrence was not reported.
The distinct final-debrief Groupthink occurrence was not reported.
The moderate-confidence huddle finding is invisible at the high-only threshold.
main_strengths: All four findings use valid, directly supporting interview quotations.
All four findings localize to the correct reasoning segments and fully capture the corresponding hidden mechanisms.
The analysis explicitly distinguishes at-time reasoning from hindsight outcome information and acknowledges unsupported corpus labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has strong mechanism-level detection but zero strict label-level true positives. It is therefore useful for separating taxonomy coverage from reasoning-mechanism coverage: the model recognized four hidden distortions while mapping them to neighboring labels and missed two distinct episodes.
